content.value_statement: Long documentation wastes context and slows AI assistants. This skill helps convert project knowledge into compact, scannable docs for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Defines rules for dense documentation using tables, bullets, and direct examples.
Lists filler words and redundant structures to remove from AI-facing docs.
Provides a CLAUDE.md style structure with stack, commands, architecture, and conventions.
Recommends progressive disclosure for long documentation using linked detail files.
Shows before-and-after examples for project overview, API, setup, and architecture docs.
limitations: It does not inspect a repository or gather facts automatically.
It does not validate whether documented commands are safe to run.
It focuses on documentation format, not code implementation or testing.
Its examples are mainly oriented toward software projects and English documentation.

use_cases.title: Create Agent Onboarding Docs
use_cases.description: Turn project conventions, commands, and architecture notes into a compact CLAUDE.md or agent guide.

use_cases.title: Compress Technical Documentation
use_cases.description: Rewrite verbose README or API content into short sections that preserve useful facts.

use_cases.title: Standardize Project Context
use_cases.description: Create consistent documentation patterns that are easy for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to scan.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner: Condense a README Section
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when a section is too verbose for AI context.
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite this documentation section for LLM context. Use tables or bullets where useful. Remove filler and keep the facts intact: [paste section]

prompt_templates.title: Intermediate: Create CLAUDE.md
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when a project needs a first agent guide.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a concise CLAUDE.md for this project. Include stack, commands, architecture, conventions, and links for deeper details: [paste project facts]

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Refactor Existing Agent Docs
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when current agent instructions are long or repetitive.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit these agent instructions for token waste. Return a shorter version and list any removed repetition, vague wording, or missing project facts: [paste docs]

prompt_templates.title: Expert: Design a Documentation Set
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when a large project needs layered context files.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an LLM-friendly documentation structure for this repository. Split quick-reference content from detailed architecture, API, and operations notes: [paste repository summary]

output_examples.input: A verbose project overview that repeats general benefits and lists technologies in paragraphs.
output: A short project heading with the product purpose.
A stack table covering frontend, backend, and database.
A feature list with only concrete capabilities.

output_examples.input: A long setup guide with narrative steps and command descriptions.
output: A setup section with required runtime version.
A brief note linking to detailed environment setup when needed.

output_examples.input: An architecture page that explains every service in paragraphs.
output: Separate links for detailed service and API references.

best_practices: Keep facts dense and remove phrases that do not change user action.
Use tables for comparisons and bullets for short operational steps.
Split long documents into a quick reference and linked detail files.
anti_patterns: Do not add meta-commentary that describes what the next section will do.
Do not replace concrete commands, paths, or conventions with vague advice.
Do not place every detail in one large file when links would reduce context load.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It helps create concise AI-facing documentation, including CLAUDE.md, README sections, technical notes, and agent instructions.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The skill is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it run project commands?
faq.answer: No. The command examples are documentation patterns only and are not executed by the skill.

faq.question: Can it write complete project documentation?
faq.answer: Yes, if you provide accurate project facts. It does not discover repository details by itself.

faq.question: Is it only for CLAUDE.md files?
faq.answer: No. It also applies to README files, technical docs, API notes, and other AI assistant context files.

faq.question: How should I prepare input for best results?
faq.answer: Provide stack details, commands, architecture notes, conventions, and links to detailed references.
